# Copilot instructions

Start with [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the authoritative project, branch, licensing, testing, and documentation rules. Check `docs/CHECKLIST.md` and `docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md` before changing a feature; update `docs/PROGRESS.md` and any affected notice/decision/request entry afterwards. Keep work on `arena/4386d633-sublearn`, preserve the NOW/LATER boundary, and never claim a build/test passed unless its actual result is observed.
